mentorDatabase.name: Dr. Anuradha Balaram
mentorDatabase.company: Indian Economic Service (retd.), 30 years in public policy
mentorDatabase.bio: Served 30 years in the Indian Economic Service, including as Economic Advisor in central Ministries, Economist at the Asian Development Bank and Chief Economic Adviser in Kerala. For the past 10 years she has worked in value education at the Vivekananda Institute of Values.

mentorDatabase.name: M S Anuradha
mentorDatabase.bio: Retired from IBM in 2021 as Offerings Program Executive for North America, after 35 years with companies including IBM, HP, Intel and AMD. She now spreads value education through VIVA's CBSE-approved school programmes.

mentorDatabase.name: Arpita Sud
mentorDatabase.company: International commercial and project finance law
mentorDatabase.bio: Holds an LLM in International Commercial Law and has worked with the International Finance Corporation. Since 2022 she has volunteered with VIVA, facilitating value education in schools and for corporates, senior citizens and women.

mentorDatabase.name: Chaitali Chatterjee
mentorDatabase.bio: Worked with the State Bank of India for 28 years. Since 2009 she has volunteered with Ramakrishna Mission VIVA, giving her time and experience to its activities.

mentorDatabase.name: Harish Dhyani
mentorDatabase.bio: An educator for 35 years who ran his own coaching institute in Mumbai until 2016. Since then he has been a master trainer for value education programmes with Ramakrishna Mission, and leads their implementation in Maharashtra.

mentorDatabase.name: Harsh
mentorDatabase.bio: Taught for 35 years in Delhi Government schools and served as Academic Advisor, guiding students in their academic and career choices. Drawn to VIVA by its focus on character building and each person's inner potential. Enjoys yoga, meditation and nature.

mentorDatabase.name: Joydrath
mentorDatabase.bio: A mechanical engineer with an Executive Development Program in Finance from IIM Calcutta. Has 20+ years of corporate experience in business development, supply chain, project management and strategy at multinationals.
tags: Spirituality & Emotional Intelligence in Corporate world

mentorDatabase.name: Koel Chakrabarty
mentorDatabase.bio: Has led technology strategy and business development across telecom, cloud, data centres and cybersecurity. Advises organisations on AI and digital infrastructure, mentors startups, and believes in Swami Vivekananda's philosophy as a force to empower youth.

mentorDatabase.name: Dr. Nandini Seshadri
mentorDatabase.bio: Holds a PhD in Biochemical Engineering and Biotechnology from IIT Delhi. Led laboratory accreditation to international standards and set up a DNA-fingerprint based quality control laboratory for basmati. A Senior Resource Person at VIVA.

mentorDatabase.name: Neha
mentorDatabase.bio: Works on conscious leadership, team performance and value education. Her dialogue-based approach blends modern psychology, NLP and Indian wisdom traditions. Author of Conversations with My Mind and co-author of Voyage of Discovery.

mentorDatabase.name: Nidhi
mentorDatabase.bio: Began as a fashion designer and has spent over 15 years in education, including teaching art to children and adults with special needs. For the past two years she has brought art and creativity into value-based education with VIVA.

mentorDatabase.name: Nivedita
mentorDatabase.bio: A teacher trainer and well-being mentor, and a former Teach For India Fellow. Her company connects education, universal values and technology to help schools support teachers, students and parents.

mentorDatabase.name: Parthasarathi Chakravorty
mentorDatabase.bio: Spent 13 years in corporate roles with organisations such as Tata Steel, PepsiCo and Dell, followed by 19 years of consulting and training.

mentorDatabase.name: Dr. Rajni Bagga
mentorDatabase.bio: Holds a Ph.D. in Psychology and led programmes in leadership, emotional intelligence, stress and conflict management for senior professionals over 33 years. Today she is an HR trainer, motivational speaker and therapist.

mentorDatabase.name: Sakshi
mentorDatabase.bio: Post Graduate in Human Resource Management with 14+ years in multinational organisations, specialising in leadership coaching and capability-building based on behavioural competencies. A Resource Person at VIVA.

mentorDatabase.name: Sancharita
mentorDatabase.bio: Understands how values shape leadership, culture and decision-making in organisations. A certified teacher of Yogic Philosophy and Hatha Yoga who studies Vedic thought and Indian scriptures and volunteers with VIVA.
tags: Practical Yogic Living for Modern Life

mentorDatabase.name: Shilpi Mukherjee Ghosh
mentorDatabase.bio: A teacher for 18 years with a background in Sociology that helps her understand students. Inspired by Swami Vivekananda, she offers her experience to VIVA as selfless service.

mentorDatabase.name: Subha
mentorDatabase.company: 11 years across technology, AI and innovation
mentorDatabase.bio: Works at the intersection of technology, education, AI and values, with a focus on responsible technology and professional ethics. Builds user-centred solutions that are meaningful and impact-oriented.

mentorDatabase.name: Sunanda Ganguli
mentorDatabase.bio: A former teacher who has worked with VIVA for the last 10 years. An avid reader who loves mountains and waterfalls.

mentorDatabase.name: Suresh
mentorDatabase.bio: Over 40 years at world-class manufacturing companies such as Sundaram-Clayton, the Rane Group and the Murugappa Group. Mentors start-ups at IIT Madras and has volunteered with VIVA for 5 years.
tags: Goal Setting and finding purpose in Life
Leadership challenges in the new era

mentorDatabase.name: Dr. Suruchi Fialoke
mentorDatabase.company: Data science, meditation and the mind
mentorDatabase.bio: A data scientist with a PhD from the University of Pennsylvania. Her research with IIT Delhi studies meditation, pranayama and fasting using tools such as EEG and functional MRI. She helps develop VIVA's courses on values and mind-strengthening tools.
tags: Science of meditation and the mind

mentorDatabase.name: Vineet Kashyap
mentorDatabase.bio: Joined VIVA in July 2026 as Coordinator, leading its programmes and stakeholder engagement. Previously led business units in HVAC and refrigeration at Carrier, and worked with Otis and A.T. Kearney.
